titulo: Three ways to say I don't know
caption:
Three ways to say I don't know

I used to answer every question with a confident guess. Then I started saying I don't know.

A confident guess can send someone the wrong way, while an honest I don't know leaves room to find out together.

For whoever says I don't know out loud.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a shelf of jars and a brick-red figure that asks is it Tuesday? in each of three labeled scenes. The bluff: a teal figure says definitely. with wide eyes. The brush-off: a brown figure says ask someone else. and looks down. The plain one: an ink-black figure tilts its head and says I don't know., and the red one answers with happy eyes. The text stays: three kinds of not knowing. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
